name: go-mailtester Local SMTP and IMAP Diagnostics
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed Go CLI for local SMTP and IMAP connection, TLS, authentication, mailbox and delivery diagnostics; no vendor-imposed usage quota or software expiry.
watch_out: Requires user-provided machine, network access and existing SMTP/IMAP servers. Sending test messages may incur provider charges or deliver real mail; do not expose credentials in shell history, and avoid -skip-verify outside controlled tests. No hosted mailbox, relay or infrastructure included.
